title: Juicy Tunisian Tomato Stir-fry
description: An earthy and juicy weeknight dish featuring a blend of aromatic spices and fresh tomatoes cooked with fast-action yeast for quick flavor development.
instructions: Preheat your pressure cooker according to manufacturer's instructions.
In the hot pressure cooker, add the chopped onions and cook until translucent, about 2 minutes.
Add garlic, tomatoes, red bell pepper, zucchini, oregano, cumin, salt, and pepper. Stir well to combine all ingredients.
Cook on high for 1 minute then reduce heat to low and allow to cook under pressure for an additional 5 minutes or until the desired consistency is reached.
Release steam from cooker using quick-release method (be careful as it will be hot).
Serve hot with crusty bread, if desired.
